llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a ProductDetails screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProductDetails is defined as a screen in the createNativeStackNavigator screens object and rendered via createStaticNavigation.
evidence: screens: { Products: ProductsScreen, ProductDetails: { screen: ProductDetailsScreen, ... } }

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must pass a title param when navigating from list to product details.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: navigation.navigate('ProductDetails', ...) only passes productId; no title param is included in either navigate call.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must handle missing productId with a deterministic fallback display instead of showing stale or undefined values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: ProductDetailsScreen checks if product exists and renders 'Product not found' when PRODUCTS_DB lookup returns undefined, preventing stale/undefined display.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must use useNavigation to get the navigation object.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useNavigation is imported and called inside ProductsScreen to obtain the navigation object.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createNativeStackNavigator is called with a static config object and the result is passed to createStaticNavigation, which is rendered as <Navigation /> in App.
